study: Song et al. 2021 / Garet et al. 2017 — Impact of Providing Performance Feedback to Teachers and Principals, NCEE 2018-4001, cluster RCT, grades 4-8, math & reading state tests
delivery_evidence: Genuine mix: the core classroom-observation feedback was delivered via in-person feedback sessions (~4/yr, ~45 min, observer reviews ratings/narrative with the teacher within 1-2 weeks), while value-added student-growth reports were disseminated through an online portal (Year 1 online only; 85%/81% accessed reports via the online portal) plus printed reports in Year 2 (Ch.2-3; Exhibit 2.2).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes are state reading/ELA and mathematics achievement tests from district administrative records (standardised to within-district z-scores) — broad independent standardised assessments not tailored to the feedback intervention (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; Exhibit J.26).
curriculum_evidence: The intervention provides performance feedback (observation ratings, value-added reports, leadership survey) to improve teachers'/principals' practice; no new curriculum, textbook, or instructional-materials package is adopted (intervention description).
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted primary effects are spring Year 2 state tests, the cumulative end of the 2-year intervention (extraction timepoint=post Year 2, end of treatment; the Year-1 wave is recorded as a secondary interim wave).
